drug_interactions.warning: Metformin combined with iodine contrast agents can increase lactic acidosis risk. Withhold 48 hours prior.
Taking NSAIDs with Aspirin increases gastrointestinal bleeding risk and reduces cardioprotective effects.
ARBs like Telmisartan retain potassium. Concurrent potassium supplements may lead to hyperkalemia.
Macrolides can marginally increase statin plasma concentrations. Monitor for muscle tenderness.
